title: Cardiologist-level arrhythmia detection and classification in ambulatory electrocardiograms using a deep neural network
outcomes_summary: Single-lead deep neural network matched cardiologist accuracy on 12 rhythm classes, F1 0.837 vs 0.780, in 91232 ECGs.

title: Automatic diagnosis of the 12-lead ECG using a deep neural network
outcomes_summary: Brazilian telehealth network DNN diagnosed six abnormal ECG classes with F1 above 80% and specificity above 99%.

title: Large-Scale Assessment of a Smartwatch to Identify Atrial Fibrillation
authors_short: Perez MV et al. (Apple Heart Study)
outcomes_summary: Among 419297 participants, 0.52% received an irregular pulse notification; PPV for AF on subsequent ECG patch was 0.84.

title: Passive Detection of Atrial Fibrillation Using a Commercially Available Smartwatch
outcomes_summary: Smartwatch deep neural network detected AF with sensitivity 98%/specificity 90% versus 12-lead ECG in cardioversion cohort.

title: Video-based AI for beat-to-beat assessment of cardiac function
outcomes_summary: Spatiotemporal CNN measured LVEF with mean absolute error 4.1% and segmented LV with Dice 0.92 on external testing.

title: Fast and accurate view classification of echocardiograms using deep learning
outcomes_summary: CNN classified 15 echo views at 92% accuracy on still images and 98% on videos.

title: Automated cardiovascular magnetic resonance image analysis with fully convolutional networks
outcomes_summary: FCN trained on 4875 UK Biobank scans achieved human-level segmentation at scale, enabling large-cohort phenotyping.

title: UK Biobank's cardiovascular magnetic resonance protocol
outcomes_summary: Defines the UK Biobank CMR acquisition protocol underlying many AI-CMR validation cohorts.

title: A deep learning algorithm using CT images to screen for COVID-19
outcomes_summary: Illustrative external-validation case underscoring distribution shift across institutions in DL imaging models.

title: High-performance medicine: the convergence of human and artificial intelligence
outcomes_summary: Influential perspective framing AI in medicine across diagnosis, augmentation, workflow, and governance.

title: Reporting guidelines for clinical trial reports for interventions involving artificial intelligence: the CONSORT-AI extension
outcomes_summary: Defines fields any AI clinical-trial report must include, including human-AI interaction and error analysis.

title: Guidelines for clinical trial protocols for interventions involving artificial intelligence: the SPIRIT-AI extension
outcomes_summary: Companion to CONSORT-AI specifying minimum protocol items for trials of AI interventions.

title: Protocol for development of a reporting guideline (TRIPOD-AI) and risk of bias tool (PROBAST-AI) for diagnostic and prognostic prediction model studies based on artificial intelligence
outcomes_summary: Outlines forthcoming TRIPOD-AI/PROBAST-AI updates that AI prediction studies will be expected to follow.

title: PROBAST: A Tool to Assess the Risk of Bias and Applicability of Prediction Model Studies
outcomes_summary: Foundational risk-of-bias tool widely used in AI prediction-model systematic reviews.

title: Reporting guideline for the early-stage clinical evaluation of decision support systems driven by artificial intelligence: DECIDE-AI
outcomes_summary: Specifies what early-stage AI decision-support evaluations should report, complementing SPIRIT/CONSORT-AI.

title: Prediction models for diagnosis and prognosis of covid-19: systematic review and critical appraisal
outcomes_summary: Cautionary systematic review showing widespread high risk of bias across published prediction models.

title: External Validation of a Widely Implemented Proprietary Sepsis Prediction Model in Hospitalized Patients
outcomes_summary: Independent validation of deployed Epic sepsis model showed substantially worse performance than vendor-reported.

title: Scalable and accurate deep learning with electronic health records
outcomes_summary: Demonstrates that DL models can use longitudinal EHR data with FHIR-style representations across multiple outcomes.

title: Artificial intelligence in cardiology
venue: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
outcomes_summary: Early influential review on AI in cardiology, framing diagnostic, predictive, and decision-support roles.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Cardiovascular Disease
venue: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
outcomes_summary: Defines methodology, biases, and clinical translational issues for AI applied to cardiovascular disease.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Cardiology: Present and Future
outcomes_summary: Synthesises AI applications across cardiology, including ECG, imaging, EHR, and pre-clinical phenotyping.

title: Deep learning for cardiovascular medicine: a practical primer
outcomes_summary: Practical primer on building, evaluating, and reporting cardiovascular deep-learning models.

title: Cognitive Machine-Learning Algorithm for Cardiac Imaging: A Pilot Study for Differentiating Constrictive Pericarditis From Restrictive Cardiomyopathy
outcomes_summary: Early ML imaging study showing improved differentiation of constrictive vs restrictive disease versus speckle echo.

title: PTB-XL, a large publicly available electrocardiography dataset
outcomes_summary: Public 21,837-record 12-lead ECG dataset that has become a standard benchmark for AI-ECG model development.

title: Deep Learning for ECG Analysis: Benchmarks and Insights from PTB-XL
venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
outcomes_summary: Reference benchmarks across architectures on PTB-XL for AI-ECG model comparison.

title: PhysioBank, PhysioToolkit, and PhysioNet: Components of a New Research Resource for Complex Physiologic Signals
outcomes_summary: Foundational open ECG/physiologic-signal resource that underpins much AI-ECG benchmarking.

title: International evaluation of an AI system for breast cancer screening
outcomes_summary: Influential external validation paper outside cardiology, often cited for benchmarking standards in clinical AI.

title: Smartwatch Performance for the Detection and Quantification of Atrial Fibrillation
outcomes_summary: Compared an Apple Watch-based AI algorithm with 12-lead ECG, reporting sensitivity 93% and specificity 84%.

title: Assessment of Remote Heart Rhythm Sampling Using the AliveCor Heart Monitor to Screen for Atrial Fibrillation
outcomes_summary: Twice-weekly AliveCor screening detected AF more often than routine care in 1001 elderly UK participants.

title: Effect of Population Screening for Atrial Fibrillation on Stroke and Mortality (LOOP Study): An Investigator-Initiated Randomized Trial
outcomes_summary: Implantable-loop-recorder AF screening tripled detection but did not reduce stroke at 5 years.

title: Yield of Screening for Atrial Fibrillation in Primary Care With a Smartphone ECG: A Cluster Randomized Trial
outcomes_summary: Single-lead AI-ECG screening did not significantly increase new AF diagnoses overall but increased detection in older subgroups.

title: Reduction in fatal and non-fatal cardiovascular events using a smartphone-based atrial fibrillation screening strategy in adults aged ≥65 years: cluster randomised controlled trial
outcomes_summary: Smartphone single-lead AF screening reduced cardiovascular events in older adults in a Hong Kong cluster RCT.

title: Electronic health record-based prediction of incident atrial fibrillation: the EHR-AF score
outcomes_summary: EHR-derived AF risk score validated in two large external cohorts with C-statistics 0.75-0.80.

title: Epidemiology, Pathophysiology, and Clinical Outcomes of Atrial Fibrillation
outcomes_summary: Updated epidemiology and risk-factor synthesis for AF that contextualizes screening and ablation programs.

title: 2014 ACC/AHA Guideline on the Assessment of Cardiovascular Risk
outcomes_summary: Foundational ASCVD risk-equation guideline that AI-based risk models are typically benchmarked against.

title: Opportunities and challenges in developing risk prediction models with electronic health records data: a systematic review
venue: Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association
outcomes_summary: Identifies recurring methodological issues for EHR-based risk models, e.g., informative missingness and validation.

title: Minimum information about clinical artificial intelligence modeling: the MI-CLAIM checklist
outcomes_summary: Defines minimum modeling-pipeline reporting expected of clinical AI publications.

title: Machine learning and artificial intelligence research for patient benefit: 20 critical questions on transparency, replicability, ethics, and effectiveness
outcomes_summary: Twenty-question framework that grant reviewers and HTA bodies are increasingly aligned with.

title: A path for translation of machine learning products into healthcare delivery
outcomes_summary: Outlines staged implementation pipeline from research model to deployed clinical AI.

title: Development and Validation of a Deep Learning Algorithm for Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy in Retinal Fundus Photographs
outcomes_summary: Frequently cited benchmark for deployable medical-image AI with prospective regulatory translation.

title: Machine learning in cardiovascular medicine: are we there yet?
outcomes_summary: Sceptical-leaning review that anticipated many of the validation, transparency, and adoption issues now seen.

title: Implementing machine learning in health care - addressing ethical challenges
outcomes_summary: Concise framing of ethical issues for clinical ML, often cited in NHS-facing AI proposals.

title: Dissecting racial bias in an algorithm used to manage the health of populations
outcomes_summary: Demonstrated how a widely deployed risk algorithm encoded racial bias via cost as a proxy for need.

title: Adapting to artificial intelligence: radiologists and pathologists as information specialists
outcomes_summary: Frames how diagnostic specialties will evolve under widespread AI adoption.

title: WHO guidance on ethics and governance of artificial intelligence for health
outcomes_summary: Six principles framework cited by NICE/MHRA-aligned proposals.

title: Foundation models for generalist medical artificial intelligence
outcomes_summary: Defines generalist medical AI / foundation-model paradigm now reshaping multimodal cardiovascular AI.

title: Large language models encode clinical knowledge
outcomes_summary: Demonstrates clinical-question performance of medically tuned LLMs and outlines remaining safety issues.

title: Capabilities of GPT-4 on Medical Challenge Problems
outcomes_summary: Frequently cited preprint benchmarking GPT-4 on medical board-style exams.

title: Comparing Physician and Artificial Intelligence Chatbot Responses to Patient Questions Posted to a Public Social Media Forum
outcomes_summary: Showed patients/clinicians often prefer LLM responses for empathy and quality on social-media questions.

title: Use of GPT-4 to Diagnose Complex Clinical Cases
outcomes_summary: GPT-4 ranked the correct diagnosis among top three in 64% of complex NEJM Clinicopathologic Conference cases.

title: ChatGPT and Cardiovascular Disease: A Pragmatic Approach
outcomes_summary: Pragmatic framing of LLM adoption across cardiology workflow, education, and patient communication.

title: EchoNet-LVH: Deep Learning Detection of Left Ventricular Hypertrophy and Cardiac Amyloidosis from Echocardiograms
outcomes_summary: DL on echocardiograms quantifies LVH and discriminates HCM, hypertensive remodeling, and amyloid.

title: Detection of Aortic Stenosis from Cardiac Ultrasound Using Deep Learning
outcomes_summary: EchoNet-style model identifies severe aortic stenosis with AUC > 0.95 across external validation cohorts.

title: Real-time guidance by deep learning of experienced operators to improve the standard of care in echocardiography
outcomes_summary: DL-guided echo acquisition improved diagnostic image quality compared with operator-only acquisition.

title: Utility of a Deep-Learning Algorithm to Guide Novices to Acquire Echocardiograms for Limited Diagnostic Use
outcomes_summary: DL coaching enabled nurses to acquire diagnostic-quality echo views, supporting decentralised imaging.

title: Mortality prediction in the ICU based on MIMIC-II results from the Super ICU Learner Algorithm (SICULA) project
outcomes_summary: Foundational ICU mortality ensemble used to compare with AI/ML models.

title: MIMIC-III, a freely accessible critical care database
outcomes_summary: Underpins many AI prognostic studies used as comparators for cardiovascular EHR models.

title: Deep Learning Identifies Cardiac Amyloidosis from Cardiac Magnetic Resonance
outcomes_summary: Multicenter CMR DL model detected cardiac amyloidosis with high accuracy across vendors.

title: Real-world implementation of artificial intelligence-assisted electrocardiogram interpretation: An ambidirectional cohort study
outcomes_summary: Hospital-wide AI-ECG deployment changed ECG read times and downstream investigations versus pre-deployment baseline.

title: Automated Quantification of Myocardial Tissue Characteristics from Native T1 Mapping Using Neural Networks With Uncertainty-Based Quality-Control
outcomes_summary: Adds uncertainty-based QC to automated CMR T1 mapping for safer routine deployment.

title: Machine Learning for Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine: A Narrative Review
outcomes_summary: Cross-discipline narrative useful for translating AI implementation lessons to cardiology.

title: Toward Trustworthy Medical AI: A Roadmap for the FDA
outcomes_summary: Frames lifecycle and post-market evidence demands likely to converge with MHRA expectations.

title: Reinforcement learning for sepsis treatment recommendations: a model-based, off-policy evaluation
outcomes_summary: Reinforcement-learning prescribing for sepsis - canonical reference for dynamic decision support in medicine.

title: Causal Machine Learning: A Practical Overview for Clinical Researchers
authors_short: Curth A, van der Schaar M
outcomes_summary: Tutorial framing for treatment-effect estimation, central to individualized cardiovascular decisions.

title: Pragmatic clinical trials of digital health: From the SHRED to the OPTIMISE-HF
outcomes_summary: Argues for pragmatic, embedded digital-health trials as the gold standard for evaluating clinical AI.

title: External Validation of a Deep Learning Electrocardiogram Algorithm to Detect Ventricular Dysfunction
outcomes_summary: External validation of Mayo low-EF AI-ECG algorithm in non-Mayo cohort with consistent diagnostic performance.

title: Prospective evaluation of smartphone-enabled cardiac telemetry in patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices
outcomes_summary: Representative real-world deployment study for wearable-AI ECG in CIED follow-up.

title: Use of artificial intelligence to detect serious illness in single-lead electrocardiograms
outcomes_summary: Single-lead-ECG DL model detected serious illness across two external US cohorts with strong calibration.

title: Implementation of Artificial Intelligence-Based Clinical Decision Support to Reduce Hospital Readmissions
outcomes_summary: Pragmatic AI-CDS evaluation for hospital readmissions illustrating implementation evidence expectations.

title: FDA-Approved Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML)-Enabled Medical Devices
outcomes_summary: FDA's living list of cleared AI/ML medical devices, including dozens of cardiology devices.

title: Apple Watch Series 4 ECG App User Manual / Marketing Authorization (FDA De Novo DEN180044)
outcomes_summary: First FDA-cleared consumer ECG/AF detection feature.

title: MHRA position paper on Software and AI as a Medical Device: pre-market expectations
venue: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency
outcomes_summary: UK regulatory expectations for SaMD/AIaMD relevant to NHS deployment.

title: BHF Cardiovascular Grand Challenge: AI-powered transformation in cardiovascular health
outcomes_summary: Up to GBP 10 million over 5 years for AI-led cardiovascular research with NHS translation focus.

title: TARGET-HF: Targeted screening for heart failure using NT-proBNP and digital tools
outcomes_summary: Representative ongoing targeted-screening trial for HF case finding using AI-enabled tools.

title: EAGLE Trial: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Electrocardiogram for Low Ejection Fraction
outcomes_summary: Pragmatic cluster RCT of AI-ECG for low EF in 22641 primary-care visits across 45 sites; intervention increased new low-EF diagnoses (2.1% vs 1.6%; OR 1.32).

title: Effect of AI-Enabled ECG on the Detection of Cardiac Amyloidosis in a Routine Clinical Setting
outcomes_summary: Prospective deployment of AI-ECG amyloid alerts increased diagnosis rates with acceptable workflow burden.

title: Multi-Modal Foundation Model for Echocardiography (EchoCLIP)
outcomes_summary: Image-text foundation model trained on echo studies for zero-shot retrieval and downstream prediction.

title: EchoNext: Multimodal AI Model for Aortic Stenosis Screening from ECG
outcomes_summary: Preprint describing the EchoNext AI-ECG model later cited for unrecognized structural heart disease.

title: Pragmatic Adoption of AI-ECG in Inpatient Wards: A Cluster-Randomized Effectiveness Trial
outcomes_summary: Hospital-wide AI-ECG cluster RCT showed mortality reduction in patients flagged high-risk versus usual care.

title: Algorithm-driven precision medicine: where do we stand?
outcomes_summary: Useful framing of where AI-driven precision medicine has actually delivered measurable benefit.

title: Validation of an Atrial Fibrillation Risk Algorithm in Population Screening
outcomes_summary: Independent validation of an AI-ECG AF risk algorithm in a population-screening setting.

title: Cost-effectiveness of AI-ECG Screening for Asymptomatic Left Ventricular Dysfunction
outcomes_summary: Cost-effectiveness analysis of AI-ECG screening pathways relevant for NICE-style appraisal.

title: Deep learning enables genotype-free cardiomyopathy screening from cardiac magnetic resonance
outcomes_summary: DL CMR phenotyping for cardiomyopathy detection without reliance on genetic testing.
